modelType: Histogram gradient-boosted trees, separate calibration and persistence blend selected by independent selection Brier
target: At least one retained S-NPP VIIRS active-fire detection in a 1.5 km cell during the next UTC day, within 12 km of prior detections.

timing.issue: I, after the I00Z GFS run is available; live path requires at least06Z

weighting: Each eligible event equal total weight. No negative downsampling. No model refit on selection/calibration after selection. Calibration fits score offsets; independent selection chooses architecture/offset/mixture and each comparator threshold. Only the fresh 2021 test estimates performance.
spatialPolicy: Metadata centers at least 25 km apart between every split; fresh test also at least 25 km from all 10 original selected 2021 incidents. Connected 2020 geographic components kept in one split. Geographic proximity is only a proxy for incident-complex identity.

confidenceIntervals.method: 1,000 paired bootstrap resamples of whole geographic test clusters; 25 km connected metadata centers. Every Brier draw retained; undefined AP draws omitted.

previousVersion.deltaConvention: new minus comparator; negative Brier and positive PR-AUC favor new model

smoothedPersistence.deltaConvention: new minus comparator; negative Brier and positive PR-AUC favor new model

persistence.deltaConvention: new minus comparator; negative Brier and positive PR-AUC favor new model

logistic.deltaConvention: new minus comparator; negative Brier and positive PR-AUC favor new model

previousVersion.comparison: Frozen original parameters on exactly the same finite-feature new test cells, with identical event weights.

protocol.releaseGate: Default v2 only if new-test event-weighted Brier strictly lower than frozen v1 AND PR-AUC at least v1. Point estimates are only a release gate; no confident improvement claim unless paired interval supports it. If failed, retain v1; no test-guided changes or refit.

releaseGate.decision: Eligible for default release after implementation checks

limitations: 250 fixed selected events yielded fewer eligible examples; no replacement was made after seeing labels or input eligibility. One randomly chosen target day per event is not nationwide or prospective validation.
Selection metrics are used for model choice and are optimistic. Calibration and selection are separate; neither replaces untouched test evidence.
25 km metadata-center grouping is only a proxy for incident complexes and leaves longer-range weather/spatial dependence.
Labels record retained S-NPP detections. Missing detections are not proof that a cell was observed clear or unburned. No satellite coverage mask is available.

The frozen historical eligibility rule does not remove NASA-listed satellite outage dates. Live source-health abstention is stricter; primary historical scores include any such gaps and are not a coverage-qualified live evaluation.
Finalized historical gridMET, WSTS rasterization and live provider differences mean historical skill does not establish live probability calibration.
Fuel structure, live/dead moisture, suppression, spotting and ignition processes are not fully observed. This is not a flame front, official warning, evacuation or crew allocation product.
S-NPP delivery cessation is scheduled for 2026-11-02 13:00 UTC. The model abstains without its matching source; another platform requires retraining.

sourceAvailabilityDiagnostics.scope: Secondary descriptive diagnostic predeclared before test access. Excludes events with NASA-listed required-input-day outages; target-day gaps remain. Primary scores, selection and release gate are unchanged. The retrospective catalogue and unknown local cloud/overpass coverage do not prove operational availability.
